description: R1 (b7-plan Unit R): the native Rust retained-precision reader's outcome on every reader input of the shared corpus, which the desktop's wasm reader must equal (src/features/results/retainedPrecisionWasmEquivalence.test.ts). Each entry: the input's key; the sha256 of the JCS form of [source, invocation or null]; per reading (bound, when the input has an invocation; unbound; transport), the sha256 of the JCS form of retained_precision::outcome_json and a summary. Written by result_export's retained_precision_contract.rs r1_native_reader_outcomes with RETAINED_READER_OUTCOMES_OUT set; test data, not evidence of execution.
